description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Ice/Lightning/NE magic attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Lv.2 En-Ice Stack or Lv.2 En-Lightning Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Ice/Lightning Damage +20%, Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases an Ice/Lightning ability with Sorcery Damage +20% for 3 turns to party (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Ice/Lightning, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Blizzard & Thunder+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
